name: Shechem
bio: Shechem is the son of Hamor the Hivite, and prince of the land. Seeing Jacob's daughter Dinah go out to visit the women of the land, he violated her; afterward he genuinely fell in love with her and begged his father Hamor to pay whatever bride-price was required to secure her as his wife (Genesis 34:1-4, 11-12). Shechem was even willing to have every male in his city circumcised to meet the condition set by Jacob's sons — Scripture says he "deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter," and that he was "more honourable than all the house of his father" (Genesis 34:19). Despite this, Simeon and Levi used the circumcision agreement as cover to kill Shechem and Hamor together while the men of the city were still in pain, avenging their sister (Genesis 34:25-26).
